source.name: Team Jayco AlUla: GreenEDGE Cycling + MAAP show off fresh new look for 2026 (kit launch)
source.quote: Thanks to MAAP for once again dropping a fresh and unique look for the new year, our 15th season in the UCI WorldTour.
source.note: The launch photos (e.g. https://greenedgecycling.com/2024/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Y2A6061-1024x683.jpg) and the MAAP product photos for the men's GreenEDGE 26 Swap-Out Pro Air Jersey 3.0 (flat-lay https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0510/7809/files/MPMJE262726_TDPG.PROAirJersey_LP_FLATLAY.png and chest detail ..._PDP_06.jpg) show 'Jayco' in large white letters across the chest, above 'ALULA'.

source.quote: It’s the day you’ve all been waiting for! – Our hot new look for 2026 is finally here.

source.name: MAAP: MAAP + GreenEDGE (2026 GreenEDGE Swap-Out Kit page)
source.quote: Created for Team Jayco AlUla and Liv AlUla Jayco ahead of cycling's biggest race, the 2026 GreenEDGE Swap-Out Kit brings a fresh look to the WorldTour.
source.note: The product photo of the men's jersey (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0510/7809/files/MPMJE262726_TDPG.PROAirJersey_LP_FLATLAY.png and ..._PDP_06.jpg) shows 'GIANT' on the upper chest, under the UCI WorldTeam badge. The jersey's small print reads 'Team Jayco AlUla Pro Cycling Team Supported by Giant CADEX Let'sGo MAAP'. Giant also supplies the team's bikes.

summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam kit by MAAP, launched 6 January 2026 in the 'Aurora' purple look with a flame motif. Jayco fills the chest and upper back, with AlUla (Arabic script over ALULA) under it on the chest, across the back and on the seat of the bib shorts; Jayco also runs down the leg of the bibs. GIANT is on the upper chest and down both sleeves, CADEX is on the upper chest, the sleeves and both legs of the bibs, three stacked MAAP marks sit on the upper chest with smaller MAAP marks on the back, and letsgo sits at the collar and on the lower back. Marked complete: the club's launch photos and MAAP's product photos of the jersey and bib (front, back and both sides) show no other sponsor. 'GreenEDGE Cycling' is the team's own wordmark, the UCI WorldTeam badge is an award and '#ExperienceAlUla' is AlUla's hashtag; none has a sponsor record. Giant also supplies the team's bikes and MAAP makes the kit.
